items.raw_excerpt: This marks the first Games in 24 years where the sailors have gone without a gold.

items.raw_excerpt: The 51-year-old former engineer first took up gelato-making more than 20 years ago as a side hustle. It has since become a lifelong passion, one that he continues to pursue through teaching and his home-based business, Ethos Gelato Lab.

items.raw_excerpt: Following a reform to the country’s justice system, researchers at Bukkyo University in Aichi Prefecture have started an experimental programme where the ancient Buddhist practice of mindfulness is used to help prisoners manage their emotions.
